chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"Whoever you associate with, if you are able for your hand to be the upper one over him, then do so."

key_terms.الْعُلْيَا: the upper one, meaning the giving or superior hand in generosity
key_terms.خَالَطْتَ: you associated or mixed with someone
key_terms.يَدُكَ: your hand, meaning your giving or practical agency

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام teach about generosity in dealing with companions?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an ethic of generosity and noble conduct in social relations. It encourages a believer to be the giver and benefactor in companionship, maintaining dignity through kindness and initiative in giving.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2427 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abu Ja‘far (as), who said:
"Whoever you associate with, if you are able to ensure that your hand is above theirs (in generosity and giving), then do so."
